title: Streetscape
body:
![Streetscape title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fa20bcad3ef24c62b8535b68f9bb74f9114d92b_0.webp)

## About

Ever wanted to build proper roads in Minecraft but got tired of pretending gray concrete and diorite stairs to look like real painted lines? Streetscape is exactly what you need!

Originally started as a simple [resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/road-markings), Streetscape has been completely rebuilt from the ground up into a full mod for all your road building needs.

![Road marking showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6123b780e22fec34a802936fe4f98336ac2d7454.png)

## Current Features

**Roadworks Table:**
Combine asphalt blocks and some dye in the Roadworks Table to stamp out the exact road marking patterns you want.

**Connected Textures:**
Line markings automatically connect to adjacent blocks to form seamless straightaways, corners, and intersections. No more puzzle-piece placing!

**Asphalt:**
Mix sand, gravel, and coal (or charcoal) to craft an Asphalt Mix, then smelt it down in a furnace to produce solid Asphalt blocks.

![All current features showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/y870PRPV/images/ec7d6f9b7e2062f405b805bfe40a5b0654354aec.jpeg)
